alex: Hey — I need a quick ops snapshot for APAC: service overview + model-health + region p95 tiles. Opening the grafana links I have returns 403. Anyone have working shortlinks or know who can grant view access?

maria: Which exact dashboards? We recently reorganized dashboards into the ops-views workspace and a bunch moved IDs.

alex: The ones from last oncall: service-overview v3, model_health_summary, and apac-latency-p95. Grafana URL I'm hitting is `/d/abcd1234/service-overview` and it 403s. Loki explore also 403.

cheng: You likely aren't in the obs-readers group. eng-platform made a self-serve RBAC UI last quarter. You can request view rights there or I can add you temporarily.

alex: If you can add me that'd be great — hitting this while triaging a customer ticket.

maria: Dropping the workspace-friendly links (should avoid the old /d/ style):
- service overview: https://grafana.internal/w/ops-views/d/abcd1234
- model health summary: https://grafana.internal/w/ops-views/d/efgh5678
- apac p95 panel: https://grafana.internal/w/ops-views/d/ijkl9012

alex: Thanks — tried the ops-views links, model health still 403 but service overview works now.

cheng: Ok — looks like model_health_summary has an additional group restriction (sensitive model telemetry). I'll open a temporary grant for you. If others need it regularly we should request team-level access.

eng-platform-bot: To request dashboard access automatically: https://platform.redwood.com/rbac-requests — include dashboard ids (abcd1234, efgh5678, ijkl9012), your team, and reason. Approvals go to eng-platform.

maria: Quick Loki example if you want the p95 from logs (paste into Explore -> Logs -> LogQL):
```
{app="inference", region="apac"} | json | unwrap(duration_ms) | quantile_over_time(0.95, duration_ms[5m])
```
This gives a rolling p95 over the last 5m; tweak the selector for specific model/job.

alex: The Loki query returned results once cheng added me — can see the spike. Thanks. Can we pin these three dashboards to the APAC team workspace so triage is faster next time?

sara: I can pin, but workspace pins need an owner recorded. @alex are you ok to own the APAC ops snapshot? Means you'll be the contact if we need to open/remove access.

alex: Yep I can own it. Also can someone add the shortlinks to the oncall runbook? Saves hunting.

maria: Will add to the runbook and the internal docs page. Also noted: if anyone hits a 403, first step is check membership in `obs-readers` and then file the RBAC request if the dashboard is sensitive.

cheng: For followup: I'll leave the temporary grant for 24h, then if you still need it we'll do the team request.

alex: Perfect — appreciate the quick help :thumbsup:
